confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Byron Bay pricing; not checked against live menus, listings, or booking pages. Drink and restaurant anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which swings with July school holidays and whale-season demand. FX is the RBA 4pm observation for 15 Oct 2026 as reported on the RBA exchange rates overview page; the F11.1 table was not opened directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against premium Australian coastal tourism towns such as Noosa and other northern NSW and southeast Queensland resort towns, adjusted for Byron Bay's high visitor demand. No specific comparable listings were checked.
